title: A context-adaptive policy framework for robust and reactive robotic manipulation via uncertainty-aware imitation learning
abstract: arXiv:2410.24035v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating robust and reactive manipulation strategies that can adapt to changing context information is a challenging task in robotics. Over the years, Learning from Demonstration (LfD) has emerged as an intuitive and effective solution for generating reactive policies, particularly by following dynamical-system(DS)-based approaches. However, most state-of-the-art DS-based approaches focus on addressing the robustness limitations, overlooking the modulation of policies in response to the environment. As a result, they tend to be inflexible with respect to parameterization by task-dependent variables. In this work, we build on existing work on policy fusion and uncertainty quantification to propose a context-adaptive policy framework that combines task-parameterized, robust and reactive manipulation. For this, we use LfD to acquire a policy that is conditioned on the robot state and low-dimensional task-dependent parameters ref

translated_title: 基于不确定性感知模仿学习的鲁棒响应式机器人操作上下文自适应策略框架
translated_abstract: 在机器人学中，生成能够适应不断变化的上下文信息的鲁棒且具有响应性的操作策略是一项具有挑战性的任务。多年来，从演示中学习已成为生成响应式策略的一种直观且有效的解决方案，特别是基于动力系统的方法。然而，大多数最先进的基于动力系统的方法专注于解决鲁棒性方面的限制，而忽略了策略对环境变化的调节。因此，这些方法在利用任务相关变量进行参数化时往往缺乏灵活性。在这项工作中，我们在现有的策略融合和不确定性量化研究的基础上，提出了一个上下文自适应策略框架，将任务参数化、鲁棒性和响应式操作相结合。为此，我们使用从演示中学习的方法来获取一个以机器人状态和低维任务相关参数为条件的策略。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于不确定性感知模仿学习的上下文自适应策略框架，通过策略融合与不确定性量化技术，首次将任务参数化、鲁棒性和响应式机器人操作三者结合，解决了现有动力系统方法无法根据任务相关变量灵活调节策略的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a context-adaptive policy framework based on uncertainty-aware imitation learning, which for the first time combines task-parameterized, robust, and reactive robotic manipulation through policy fusion and uncertainty quantification, addressing the inflexibility of existing dynamical-system-based approaches in adapting to task-dependent variables.
